shloka_text: श्रुत्वा तूशनसं क्रुद्धं तदा ऽ ऽर्तो नहुषात्मजः । जरां परमिकां प्राप्य यदुं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। 7.59.1 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā tūśanasaṃ kruddhaṃ tadā ' 'rto nahuṣātmajaḥ | jarāṃ paramikāṃ prāpya yaduṃ vacanamabravīt || 7.59.1 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु indeed, ऊशनसम् Ushanas (Shukra), क्रुद्धम् angry, तदा then, आर्तः distressed, नहुषात्मजः the son of Nahusha (Yayati), जराम् old age, परमिकाम् extreme, प्राप्य having obtained, यदुम् to Yadu, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Having heard that Ushanas was angry, the distressed son of Nahusha, Yayati, then, having immediately obtained extreme old age, spoke these words to Yadu.
comments: Cursed with premature old age by Shukra, Yayati asks his sons to bear it; Yadu refuses but Puru accepts -- young again, Yayati enjoys life for ages, then returns the burden to Puru, anoints him king, and curses the refusing Yadu, whose line is cast out -- Rama draws the lesson of forbearance, and as he finishes, dawn breaks.

shloka_text: यदो त्वमसि धर्मज्ञो मदर्थं प्रतिगृह्यताम् । जरां परमिकां पुत्र भोगै रंस्ये महायशः ।। 7.59.2 ।।
transliteration: yado tvamasi dharmajño madarthaṃ pratigṛhyatām | jarāṃ paramikāṃ putra bhogai raṃsye mahāyaśaḥ || 7.59.2 ||
translation: यदो O Yadu, त्वम् you, असि are, धर्मज्ञः knower of dharma, मदर्थम् for my sake, प्रतिगृह्यताम् let it be accepted (by you), जराम् old age, परमिकाम् extreme, पुत्र O son, भोगैः with enjoyments, रंस्ये I shall delight, महायशः O greatly renowned one.
explanation: Yayati said, "O Yadu, you are a knower of righteousness; for my sake, please accept this extreme old age, O son, so that I, O greatly renowned one, may delight in enjoyments."

shloka_text: न तावत्कृतकृत्यो ऽस्मि विषयेषु नरर्षभ । अनुभूय तदा कामं ततः प्राप्स्याम्यहं जराम् ।। 7.59.3 ।।
transliteration: na tāvatkṛtakṛtyo 'smi viṣayeṣu nararṣabha | anubhūya tadā kāmaṃ tataḥ prāpsyāmyahaṃ jarām || 7.59.3 ||
translation: न not, तावत् yet, कृतकृत्यः fulfilled (my desires), अस्मि I am, विषयेषु in worldly pleasures, नरर्षभ O best among men, अनुभूय having experienced, तदा then, कामम् desire, ततः thereafter, प्राप्स्यामि I shall obtain, अहम् I, जराम् old age.
explanation: Yayati continued, "O best among men, I am not yet satisfied with worldly pleasures; only after fully experiencing my desires will I then accept old age."

shloka_text: यदुस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रत्युवाच नरर्षभम् । पुत्रस्ते दयितः पूरुः प्रतिगृह्णातु वै जराम् ।। 7.59.4 ।।
transliteration: yadustadvacanaṃ śrutvā pratyuvāca nararṣabham | putraste dayitaḥ pūruḥ pratigṛhṇātu vai jarām || 7.59.4 ||
translation: यदुः Yadu, तत् those, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रत्युवाच replied, नरर्षभम् to the best among men, पुत्रः son, ते your, दयितः beloved, पूरुः Puru, प्रतिगृह्णातु let him accept, वै indeed, जराम् old age.
explanation: Having heard those words, Yadu replied to his father, the best among men, saying, "Let your beloved son Puru indeed accept this old age."

shloka_text: बहिष्कृतो ऽहमर्थेषु सन्निकर्षाच्च पार्थिव । प्रतिगृह्णातु वै राजन्क सहाश्नाति भोजनम् ।। 7.59.5 ।।
transliteration: bahiṣkṛto 'hamartheṣu sannikarṣācca pārthiva | pratigṛhṇātu vai rājanka sahāśnāti bhojanam || 7.59.5 ||
translation: बहिष्कृतो excluded, अहम् I, अर्थेषु from worldly pleasures, सन्निकर्षात् due to old age, च and, पार्थिव O king, प्रतिगृह्णातु let him accept, वै indeed, राजन् O king, क who, सहाश्नाति eats together, भोजनम् food.
explanation: O King, I am excluded from worldly pleasures due to old age; who indeed would eat food with me?

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राजा पूरुमथाब्रवीत् । इयं जरा महाबाहो मदर्थं प्रतिगृह्यताम् ।। 7.59.6 ।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rājā pūrumathābravīt | iyaṃ jarā mahābāho madarthaṃ pratigṛhyatām || 7.59.6 ||
translation: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, राजा the king, पूरुम् to Puru, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, इयम् this, जरा old age, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, मदर्थम् for my sake, प्रतिगृह्यताम् let it be accepted.
explanation: Having heard his words, the king then spoke to Puru, saying, "O mighty-armed one, let this old age be accepted for my sake."

shloka_text: नाहुषेणैवमुक्तस्तु पूरुः प्राञ्जलिरब्रवीत् । धन्यो ऽस्म्यनुगृहीतो ऽस्मि शासने ऽस्मि तव स्थितः ।। 7.59.7 ।।
transliteration: nāhuṣeṇaivamuktastu pūruḥ prāñjalirabravīt | dhanyo 'smyanugṛhīto 'smi śāsane 'smi tava sthitaḥ || 7.59.7 ||
translation: नाहुषेण by Nahusha's son, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, पूरुः Puru, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, अब्रवीत् spoke, धन्यः blessed, अस्मि I am, अनुगृहीतः favored, अस्मि I am, शासने in the command, अस्मि I am, तव your, स्थितः abiding.
explanation: Thus addressed by Yayati, Puru spoke with folded hands, saying, "I am blessed, I am favored, and I abide by your command."

shloka_text: पूरोर्वचनमाज्ञाय नाहुषः परया मुदा । प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे जरां सङ्क्रामयच्च ताम् ।। 7.59.8 ।।
transliteration: pūrorvacanamājñāya nāhuṣaḥ parayā mudā | praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe jarāṃ saṅkrāmayacca tām || 7.59.8 ||
translation: पूरोः Puru's, वचनम् word, आज्ञाय having understood, नाहुषः Nahusha's son, परया with great, मुदा joy, प्रहर्षम् delight, अतुलम् unequalled, लेभे obtained, जराम् old age, सङ्क्रामयत् transferred, च and, ताम् that.
explanation: Having understood Puru's words, Yayati obtained unequalled delight with great joy and transferred that old age to him.

shloka_text: ततः स राजा तरुणः प्राप्य यज्ञान्सहस्रशः । बहुवर्षसहस्राणि पालयामास मेदिनीम् ।। 7.59.9 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sa rājā taruṇaḥ prāpya yajñānsahasraśaḥ | bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi pālayāmāsa medinīm || 7.59.9 ||
translation: ततः thereafter, सः that, राजा king, तरुणः young, प्राप्य having obtained, यज्ञान् sacrifices, सहस्रशः by thousands, बहुवर्षसहस्राणि for many thousands of years, पालयमास ruled, मेदिनीम् the earth.
explanation: Thereafter, that king, having become young again, performed thousands of sacrifices and ruled the earth for many thousands of years.

shloka_text: अथ दीर्घस्य कालस्य राजा पूरुमथाब्रवीत् । आनयस्व जरां पुत्र न्यासं निर्यातयस्व मे ।। 7.59.10 ।।
transliteration: atha dīrghasya kālasya rājā pūrumathābravīt | ānayasva jarāṃ putra nyāsaṃ niryātayasva me || 7.59.10 ||
translation: अथ then, दीर्घस्य कालस्य after a long time, राजा the king, पूरुम् to Puru, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, आनयस्व bring back, जराम् old age, पुत्र O son, न्यासम् the deposit, निर्यातयस्व return, मे to me.
explanation: After a long time, King Yayati then spoke to Puru, saying, "O son, bring back my old age; return the deposit to me."

shloka_text: न्यासभूता मया पुत्र त्वयि सङ्क्रामिता जरा । तस्मात्प्रतिग्रहीष्यामि तां जरां मा व्यथां कृथाः ।। 7.59.11 ।।
transliteration: nyāsabhūtā mayā putra tvayi saṅkrāmitā jarā | tasmātpratigrahīṣyāmi tāṃ jarāṃ mā vyathāṃ kṛthāḥ || 7.59.11 ||
translation: न्यासभूता as a deposit, मया by me, पुत्र O son, त्वयि in you, सङ्क्रामिता transferred, जरा old age, तस्मात् therefore, प्रतिग्रहीष्यामि I will take back, ताम् that, जराम् old age, मा व्यथाम् कृथाः do not feel distressed.
explanation: O son, that old age was transferred to you by me as a deposit; therefore, I will take it back, so do not feel distressed.

shloka_text: प्रीतश्चास्मि महाबाहो शासनस्य प्रतिग्रहात् । त्वां चाहमभिषेक्ष्यामि प्रीतियुक्तो नराधिपम् ।। 7.59.12 ।।
transliteration: prītaścāsmi mahābāho śāsanasya pratigrahāt | tvāṃ cāhamabhiṣekṣyāmi prītiyukto narādhipam || 7.59.12 ||
translation: प्रीतः pleased, च and, अस्मि I am, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, शासनस्य of the command, प्रतिग्रहात् by the acceptance, त्वाम् you, च and, अहम् I, अभिषेक्ष्यामि will anoint, प्रीतियुक्तः filled with affection, नराधिपम् as king of men.
explanation: O mighty-armed one, I am pleased by your acceptance of my command, and I will affectionately anoint you as the king of men.

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा सुतं पूरुं ययातिर्नहुषात्मजः । देवयानीसुतं क्रुद्धो राजा वाक्यमुवाच ह ।। 7.59.13 ।।
transliteration: evamuktvā sutaṃ pūruṃ yayātirnahuṣātmajaḥ | devayānīsutaṃ kruddho rājā vākyamuvāca ha || 7.59.13 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, सुतम् to son, पूरुम् Puru, ययातिः Yayati, नहुषात्मजः son of Nahusha, देवयानीसुतम् to Devayani's son, क्रुद्धः enraged, राजा the king, वाक्यम् words, उवाच ह spoke indeed.
explanation: Having thus spoken to his son Puru, King Yayati, the son of Nahusha, then spoke enraged words to Devayani's son.

shloka_text: राक्षसस्त्वं मया जातः पुत्ररूपो दुरासदः । प्रतिहंसि ममाज्ञां यत् प्रजार्थे विफलो भव ।। 7.59.14 ।।
transliteration: rākṣasastvaṃ mayā jātaḥ putrarūpo durāsadaḥ | pratihaṃsi mamājñāṃ yat prajārthe viphalo bhava || 7.59.14 ||
translation: राक्षसः a demon, त्वम् you, मया by me, जातः born, पुत्ररूपः in the form of a son, दुरासदः wicked, प्रतिहंसि you reject, मम आज्ञाम् my command, यत् because, प्रजार्थे for the purpose of progeny, विफलः fruitless, भव become.
explanation: You are a wicked demon born by me in the form of a son, because you reject my command, you shall become fruitless in terms of progeny.

shloka_text: पितरं गुरुभूतं मां यस्मात्त्वमवमन्यसे । राक्षसान्यातुधानांस्त्वं जनयिष्यसि दारुणान् ।। 7.59.15 ।।
transliteration: pitaraṃ gurubhūtaṃ māṃ yasmāttvamavamanyase | rākṣasānyātudhānāṃstvaṃ janayiṣyasi dāruṇān || 7.59.15 ||
translation: पितरं father, गुरुभूतं who is like a preceptor, मां me, यस्मात् because, त्वम् you, अवमन्यसे disrespect, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, यातुधानान् Yatudhanas, त्वम् you, जनयिष्यसि will give birth to, दारुणान् terrible.
explanation: Because you disrespect me, your father and preceptor, you will give birth to terrible Rakshasas and Yatudhanas.

shloka_text: न तु सोमकुलोत्पन्ने वंशे स्थास्यति दुर्मतेः । वंशो ऽपि भवतस्तुल्यो दुर्विनीतो भविष्यति ।। 7.59.16 ।।
transliteration: na tu somakulotpanne vaṃśe sthāsyati durmateḥ | vaṃśo 'pi bhavatastulyo durvinīto bhaviṣyati || 7.59.16 ||
translation: न not, तु indeed, सोमकुलोत्पन्ने born in the Lunar dynasty, वंशे in the lineage, स्थास्यति will remain, दुर्मतेः of the evil-minded one, वंशो lineage, अपि also, भवतः your, तुल्यः similar, दुर्विनीतः ill-behaved, भविष्यति will be.
explanation: The lineage of that evil-minded one (Yati) will not endure in the Lunar dynasty, and your own progeny will also be ill-behaved like you.

shloka_text: तमेवमुक्त्वा राजर्षिः पूरुं राज्यविवर्धनम् । अभिषेकेण सम्पूज्य आश्रमं प्रविवेश ह ।। 7.59.17 ।।
transliteration: tamevamuktvā rājarṣiḥ pūruṃ rājyavivardhanam | abhiṣekeṇa sampūjya āśramaṃ praviveśa ha || 7.59.17 ||
translation: तम् him, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having said, राजर्षिः the royal sage, पूरुं Puru, राज्यविवर्धनम् who would expand the kingdom, अभिषेकेण with coronation, सम्पूज्य having honored, आश्रमं hermitage, प्रविवेश entered, ह indeed.
explanation: Having thus spoken, the royal sage Yayati honored Puru, who was destined to expand the kingdom, with a coronation and then entered his hermitage.

shloka_text: ततः कालेन महता दिष्टान्तमुपजग्मिवान् । त्रिदिवं सङ्गतो राजा ययातिर्नहुषात्मजः ।। 7.59.18 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ kālena mahatā diṣṭāntamupajagmivān | tridivaṃ saṅgato rājā yayātirnahuṣātmajaḥ || 7.59.18 ||
translation: ततः thereafter, कालेन by time, महता great, दिष्टान्तम् end of destiny, उपजग्मिवान् reached, त्रिदिवं heaven, सङ्गतः went to, राजा king, ययातिः Yayati, नहुषात्मजः son of Nahusha.
explanation: After a long time, King Yayati, the son of Nahusha, reached the end of his life and ascended to heaven.

shloka_text: पूरुश्चकार तद्राज्यं धर्मेण महता वृतः । प्रतिष्ठाने पुरवरे काशिराज्ये महायशाः ।। 7.59.19 ।।
transliteration: pūruścakāra tadrājyaṃ dharmeṇa mahatā vṛtaḥ | pratiṣṭhāne puravare kāśirājye mahāyaśāḥ || 7.59.19 ||
translation: पूरुः Puru, चकार ruled, तद्राज्यं that kingdom, धर्मेण with righteousness, महता great, वृतः endowed with, प्रतिष्ठाने in Pratishthana, पुरवरे in the excellent city, काशिराज्ये in the kingdom of Kashi, महायशाः greatly renowned.
explanation: The greatly renowned Puru, endowed with great righteousness, ruled that kingdom from the excellent city of Pratishthana in the Kashi region.

shloka_text: यदुस्तु जनयामास यातुधानान्सहस्रशः । पुरे क्रौञ्चवने दुर्गे राजवंशबहिष्कृतः ।। 7.59.20 ।।
transliteration: yadustu janayāmāsa yātudhānānsahasraśaḥ | pure krauñcavane durge rājavaṃśabahiṣkṛtaḥ || 7.59.20 ||
translation: यदुस्तु Yadu, however, जनयामास begot, यातुधानान् Rākṣasas, सहस्रशः by thousands, पुरे in the region, क्रौञ्चवने of Krauñcavana, दुर्गे in a difficult-to-access place, राजवंशबहिष्कृतः excluded from the royal lineage.
explanation: King Yadu, having been excluded from the royal lineage, begot thousands of Rākṣasas in the inaccessible region of Krauñcavana.

shloka_text: एष तूशनसा मुक्तः शापोत्सर्गो ययातिना । धारितः क्षत्रधर्मेण यन्निमिश्च न चक्षमे ।। 7.59.21 ।।
transliteration: eṣa tūśanasā muktaḥ śāpotsargo yayātinā | dhāritaḥ kṣatradharmeṇa yannimiśca na cakṣame || 7.59.21 ||
translation: एषः this, तु indeed, उशनसा by Uśanas, मुक्तः given, शापोत्सर्गः the curse, ययातिना by Yayāti, धारितः was borne, क्षत्रधर्मेण by the duty of a Kṣatriya, यत् which, निमिश्च and Nimi, न not, चक्षमे tolerated.
explanation: This curse, given by Uśanas, was indeed borne by Yayāti due to his Kṣatriya duty, a burden which even Nimi could not tolerate.

shloka_text: एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं दर्शनं सर्वकारिणाम् । अनुवर्तामहे सौम्य दोषो न स्याद्यथा नृगे ।। 7.59.22 ।।
transliteration: etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ darśanaṃ sarvakāriṇām | anuvartāmahe saumya doṣo na syādyathā nṛge || 7.59.22 ||
translation: एतत् this, ते to you, सर्वम् all, आख्यातम् has been narrated, दर्शनम् the lesson, सर्वकारिणाम् for all actions, अनुवर्तामहे we shall follow, सौम्य O gentle one, दोषः fault, न स्यात् may not be, यथा as, नृगे in Nṛga.
explanation: O gentle one, all this has been narrated to you as a lesson for all actions, so that we may follow it and avoid a fault like that of Nṛga.

shloka_text: इति कथयति रामे चन्द्रतुल्यानने च प्रविरलतरतारं व्योम जज्ञे तदानीम् । अरुणकिरणरक्ता दिग्बभौ चैव पूर्वा कुसुमरसविमुक्तं वस्त्रमाकुण्ठितेव ।। 7.59.23 ।।
transliteration: iti kathayati rāme candratulyānane ca praviralataratāraṃ vyoma jajñe tadānīm | aruṇakiraṇaraktā digbabhau caiva pūrvā kusumarasavimuktaṃ vastramākuṇṭhiteva || 7.59.23 ||
translation: इति thus, कथयति while speaking, रामे Rāma, चन्द्रतुल्यानने whose face was like the moon, च and, प्रविरलतरतारम् with stars becoming very sparse, व्योम the sky, जज्ञे became, तदानीम् at that time, अरुणकिरणरक्ता reddened by the rays of dawn, दिक् the direction, बभौ shone, चैव and indeed, पूर्वा the eastern, कुसुमरसविमुक्तम् a garment released from flower juice (faded), वस्त्रम् garment, आकुण्ठितेव as if rolled up.
explanation: As Rāma, whose face was like the moon, spoke thus, the sky at that time became very sparse with stars, and the eastern direction shone, reddened by the rays of dawn, like a faded garment being rolled up. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकोनषष्टितमः सर्गः ।। 59 ।। Thus ends the fifty-ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
